text: The authors report that a simple regex keyword algorithm (e.g. 'open-label' implies no placebo, 'placebo' implies placebo) does about as well as their task decomposition on placebo classification. They argue keyword approaches do not generalise to harder, more ambiguous tasks such as adherence, which is described with varied wording.
title: Simple regex keyword baseline matches decomposition on placebo classification
